## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the bug or recognition error.

## Diagram Category

- [ ] Flowchart
- [ ] Bar Chart
- [ ] Pie Chart
- [ ] Sequence Diagram
- [ ] Data Flow Diagram (DFD)
- [ ] Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Image Source

- [ ] Printed vector / digital export
- [ ] Hand-drawn scan / photograph
- [ ] Software screenshot
- [ ] Scanned PDF page

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Launch ODR (`python run_odr.py` and `npm run dev`).
2. Upload image `...`.
3. Select region `...`.
4. Click 'Recognize & Edit'.
5. Observe the behavior.

## Expected Behavior

Describe what nodes, connectors, directions, or labels should have been recognized.

## Actual Behavior

Describe what was actually produced (e.g. missing connection, inverted arrow, OCR typo).

## Test Artifact

If possible, attach an anonymized/redacted sample image demonstrating the issue. Do NOT upload proprietary, confidential, or sensitive documents.

## Environment Information

- Operating System: [e.g. Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma]
- Python Version: [e.g. 3.11.8]
- Node Version: [e.g. 20.11.0]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124, Firefox 125, Edge]
- ODR Version / Commit Hash: [e.g. 2.0.0 / commit hash]
